'''Long Claw''' was a [[jurgoran]] residing on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] around [[3641 BBY]].

==Behind the scenes==
Long Claw appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on the planet Belsavis. He is not directly involved in any quests, however he can be killed by characters of both factions for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means he was killed.
